trace.clearConfirm: Clear buffered traces? Already-exported spans are unaffected.
trace.detail.truncated: Span cap reached; remaining spans were not recorded.
trace.list.emptyDisabled: Tracing is off, so nothing is recorded.
trace.list.emptyHelp: Send a request and it will show up here.
trace.list.emptySampled: The sampling ratio is low and no request has been picked yet. Set it to 100% and retry.
trace.list.hint: Sampled requests only. Click a row to open the waterfall.
trace.list.title: Recent traces
trace.notice.disabledHint: Enable it in configuration and restart the gateway to start recording.
trace.notice.failed: Tracing is configured but failed to start
trace.notice.failedHint: The gateway is still proxying traffic, it just is not recording spans. Check the endpoint and restart.
trace.notice.inMemoryHint: Traces stay in the buffer below and are not exported to Jaeger / Tempo.
trace.subtitle: Where each request spent its time, hop by hop. Spans come from OpenTelemetry and can be exported to Jaeger / Tempo as well.
trace.title: Distributed Tracing
trace.band.samplingHint: new requests only, no restart needed
trace.detail.copyHint: Click to copy the trace id
trace.wf.hint: Click a row to see its attributes
trace.auth.title: Export authentication
trace.auth.help: These headers are attached to every OTLP export. Existing values are never echoed back; leaving a row empty means no panel override, falling back to configuration or environment variables.
trace.auth.restartHint: A restart is required before the exporter uses the new credential.
trace.auth.saved: Saved. Restart the gateway to apply.
trace.auth.fromConfigHint: Set in appsettings.json — edit it there
trace.probe.title: Send an empty batch to this endpoint to check the address and credential
trace.probe.caveat: Proves the address is reachable and the credential is accepted — not that spans are stored.
trace.probe.caveatFail: The exporter keeps trying and silently dropping batches until the address recovers.
trace.probe.note.grpcPathIgnored: gRPC ignores the path in Endpoint
trace.probe.note.grpcNoH2c: Port answers but refuses plaintext HTTP/2 — gRPC is usually on another port
trace.probe.note.authChallenge: This address rejects the current credential type — see WWW-Authenticate below; the secret itself may be fine
